description: Search everything vike knows by name, symbol or address in one call, the same search as the vike.io search box. Sections: `tokens` (live price, 24h change and the page to open), `hl_markets` (Hyperliquid builder markets such as xyz:GOLD), `wallets` (labelled entities and wallets on Ethereum, BSC, Base and HyperEVM; an entity row has `wallet_count` and `url`, the vike.io page listing its wallets, and an `address` only when it is one wallet; a type word such as `cex`, `bridge` or `hacker` lists that type's biggest entities), `traders`, `vaults` and `builders` (Hyperliquid), `polymarket` (Polymarket wallets by name, pseudonym or address, with the owner of an account or the accounts a personal wallet owns), `markets` (open Polymarket markets holding every word, several markets of one event as one row {event_slug, title, markets_n}; closed ones only when nothing else matched), `predictfun` (open Predict.fun markets on BNB Chain whose title or question holds every word, the busiest (24 h volume) first, then the newest, each {market_id, title, question, status, url}; closed and resolved ones only when nothing else matched; a pasted address that has traded there is one {address, url} row) and `did_you_mean` (coins one typo away when no token matched). `q` may be free text, a 0x address (also inside a pasted URL), an ENS name (searched as the address it points to) or a polymarket.com link. Each section holds at most `limit` rows; a section whose read fails comes back empty rather than failing the call. `url` fields are vike.io paths. Use it to turn a name into an address or id before calling another tool. Same data as GET /v1/search.

q.description: What to look for, 1 to 256 characters: a name, symbol, label, address, ENS name or polymarket.com link. Filter words may go with it or alone: `chain:base` (eth, bsc, base, hyperevm), `type:cex` (an entity type), `pnl>1m` or `pnl<-100k` (traders' all-time PnL; k, m, b).
